newsitem.title: USA: Calif. governor names trade and commerce official.
newsitem.headline: Calif. governor names trade and commerce official.

text.p: California Gov. Pete Wilson on Monday appointed Luis Buhler as deputy secretary for economic development at the state's Trade and Commerce Agency.
Buhler, 43, of Cupertino, served as vice president of international marketing with Trans Ocean Ltd from 1995 to 1996. Buhler, a Republican, joined Trans Ocean in 1988.
The appointment does not require Senate confirmation.
